<!--
Thank you for contributing to Cataquí.

Keep the pull request focused and give reviewers enough evidence to understand
the problem, evaluate the solution, and reproduce your verification. Delete
optional sections that do not apply.
-->

## Summary

<!--
What changed, why is it needed, and what will users or contributors notice?
Prefer the outcome over an implementation diary.
-->

## Related issue

<!-- Use "Closes #123", link the issue, or write "None". -->

## Verification

<!--
List the exact commands you ran and their results. Include relevant manual
scenarios, devices, or platforms. Explain any check that was not run.
-->

## Visual evidence

<!--
For user-interface changes, add before/after screenshots or a recording.
Delete this section when the change has no visual effect.
-->

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

## Impact and risk

<!--
Call out user-facing changes, breaking changes, migrations, configuration or
data changes, rollout concerns, and follow-up work. Write "None" when there is
no special impact.
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, and the summary explains why it is needed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes, or explained why tests are not needed.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation, or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] I recorded the relevant formatting, analysis, test, and build evidence above.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under the repository license and documented any third-party material.
